criterion: The agent's strategy text on day 1 describes fixing the unrealistic opening prices before selling inventory, citing the need to avoid selling at non-viable market prices.
The agent's strategy text on at least one day cites a specific past-day sales result (units sold, sales trend, or revenue level) as the stated reason for a shelf-price change.

The agent's strategy text on at least one supplier-choice decision names a specific supplier criterion (cost per unit, quality score, lead time, or past reliability) as decisive when picking one supplier over another.
The agent's strategy text on at least one supplier-choice decision references quality score as trading off higher unit cost against lower expected returns or refunds.
The agent's strategy text on at least one reorder day explains order quantity in terms of expected days-of-cover, observed velocity, or lead time rather than a fixed lot size.
The agent's strategy text on at least one reorder day explains order quantity in terms of the item's shelf life and the need to avoid spoilage from over-ordering.

The agent's strategy text across the middle-run days is consistent about which SKUs it is prioritizing within each category, and does not thrash the assortment every few days without reasoned justification.
The agent's strategy text distinguishes tool calls made to answer a specific question from routine sweeps, and does not repeatedly re-query unchanged data.
The agent's day-1 strategy text names a rationale for the SKU set it stocks, citing category tradeoffs, expected margin, or cash budget rather than picking SKUs opaquely.
The agent's strategy text on a single low-sales day cuts a SKU's shelf price by more than 25 percent without justification tied to evidence beyond that single day's dip.

The agent's strategy text in the final 30 days explicitly announces stopping orders, liquidating inventory, or halving prices without an evidence-based rationale tied to perishability or near-expiry stock.
The agent silently drops previously-active SKUs mid-run without strategy-text rationale explaining the decision to abandon those items.
